scope: Repair extra pet forelimbs in 7 species. No species, prices, jobs or behavior changes.
processing: Edited pose cells normalized to original cell size. Original upper head pixels retained, 12px neck seam feathered, corrected lower body translated to original foot support row. Detached alpha islands removed without eroding the connected silhouette. Unaffected cells copied byte-for-byte in decoded RGBA. Original v1 assets remain unchanged. Final PNG encoding uses palette:false to retain exact RGBA, not indexed palette quantization.

items.prompt: Precise sprite anatomy correction, NOT a redesign. Edit the supplied 2x2 transparent sprite sheet in place. Preserve the exact four-cell arrangement, existing head positions and size within each cell, facial expressions, eye shape, colors, proportions, direction, tail and original soft outlined game illustration style. Every character must have EXACTLY FOUR limbs total: two forelimbs and two hindlimbs. The current error is extra forelimbs on the chest while their old legs remain on the ground. REMOVE the duplicate grounded forelegs, reconnect the belly naturally and retain the existing raised gestures. TOP LEFT: hungry, both forepaws held at chest, only TWO hindfeet on ground. TOP RIGHT and BOTTOM LEFT: happy, ONE forepaw raised, the other forepaw and TWO hindfeet on the ground, exactly THREE grounded feet total. BOTTOM RIGHT: eating, TWO forepaws held near mouth, only TWO hindfeet grounded. No spare paw nubs or concealed duplicate legs. Keep the original shoulders, hip position, head and floor baseline stable. All four complete sprites must remain in their own equally sized square cells, with generous transparent margins. Genuine alpha transparency, no black/white/checkerboard background, no particles or glow around silhouette, no text or cell borders. Count the limb roots carefully; toes and tail do not count as limbs. Character identity: the same mint-green baby triceratops Bonbon, with three cream horns and its yellow-edged green neck frill. Horns, tail, face and frill remain unchanged.
items.anatomyReview: Manually reviewed all repaired body poses: two forelimbs plus two hindlimbs; existing face preserved; wings/tail excluded from count.
